angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology helps people keep in touch easily by allowing them to communicate over long distances.

angles.en: Technology can cause a problem with face-to-face talk because people spend too much time looking at screens.

angles.en: Technology helps people keep in touch with friends.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology has a negative effect on face-to-face talks.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology helps maintain connections over long distances by allowing people to talk to family and friends who live far away.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology helps maintain connections over long distances by allowing people to talk to family and friends who live far away.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Relying too much on screens can reduce face-to-face interaction, which is a negative aspect of using technology for talking to others.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses the positive aspects of face-to-face communication, focusing on its ability to build trust and connection through non-verbal cues.

plan.focus: evaluate the impact of technology on interpersonal communication, considering both positive and negative aspects
keyArguments: Technology has made communication more efficient and accessible through social media and instant messaging.
However, it has also led to a decrease in face-to-face interactions and the loss of nonverbal cues.
